guide.summary: Council treated name-resolution failures as a local DNS cache issue before deeper adapter resets.
guide.chiefVerdict: Flush DNS, toggle connectivity once, then retest the failing hostname.

councilDiscussion.content: KB/network-connectivity and dns-flush both prefer cache flush over full stack reset.
councilDiscussion.headline: Flush first

steps.title: Flush DNS cache
steps.instructions: Run the PatchGuard Optimize Flush DNS cache step, then retry the site or update download that failed.

steps.title: Toggle network briefly
steps.instructions: Toggle airplane mode or unplug and reconnect Ethernet once, then confirm the hostname resolves again.
